waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: split-dispatch
mutations.why: An `await` in front of the FILE_EDIT_REPORT handler (ws-router #dispatch): a frame read before its connection ended is handled after the drop, and that dead connection's report counts until the next launch.

mutations.name: no-forget-on-drop
mutations.why: fb2f902's bug as it was before: a dropped page's last report (clean) stays, so an offline page that edits later is read as clean forever.

mutations.name: forget-whole-window
mutations.why: A drop forgets every report of the window (the per-window store fb2f902 shipped): one page's drop erases the other live page's dirty tab.

mutations.name: report-per-window
mutations.why: 09f8b6af's bug: one report per window, so a second page's fresh `null` overwrites the first page's unsaved tab.
mutations.replace: Write(s, c, v) == [x \in ConnIds |-> IF x = c \/ s[x] # Absent THEN v ELSE s[x]]

mutations.name: no-report-on-open
mutations.why: FileEditReporter stops resending on `open`: a reconnected page with unsaved edits stays unreported, and its tab is released.

mutations.name: close-ignores-dirty
mutations.why: A close path releases without asking the store (a caller-side re-decision that drops the dirty check).

mutations.name: dirty-needs-every-connection
mutations.why: `edits` says dirty only when every connection names the tab: one page's `null` hides another's unsaved tab from the close.
mutations.search: IN IF \E c \in reported : store[c] = t THEN "dirty"
mutations.replace: IN IF reported # {} /\ \A c \in reported : store[c] = t THEN "dirty"
